question:
Match the following:

 
 

 
 
A.

 
 
 
Citric Acid

 
 
 
1.

 
 
 
Basic

 
 
 

 
 
B.

 
 
 
Quicklime

 </td
solution:
The correct answer is __**3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Citric acid (A-3):** It is an organic acid found naturally in citrus fruits like lemons, limes, and oranges.
 
• **Quicklime (B-1):** It is chemically calcium oxide (CaO) and is basic in nature. It is commonly used in construction and industrial processes.
 
• **Common Salt (C-2):** Sodium chloride (NaCl) is the chemical composition of common salt, used widely in cooking and food preservation.
 
• **Bleaching Powder (D-4):** Its chemical formula is CaOCl2, and it is used as a disinfectant and bleaching agent.
 
• *Hence, the correct matching is A-3, B-1, C-2, and D-4, aligning with option 3.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Citric Acid:**

 
 
• It has the chemical formula C6H8O7 and is widely used as a food additive and preservative due to its sour taste.
 
• It is also used in cleaning products to remove hard water stains due to its acidic properties.
 
 
 
• **Quicklime:**
 
 
• Produced by heating limestone (CaCO3) in a process called calcination.
 
• It reacts with water to form slaked lime (Ca(OH)2), releasing heat in an exothermic reaction.
 
 
 
• **Common Salt:**
 
 
• Essential for human health, it helps maintain fluid balance and nerve transmission in the body.
 
• It has industrial applications, such as in the production of chlorine, caustic soda, and soda ash.
 
 
 
• **Bleaching Powder:**
 
 
• A mixture of calcium hypochlorite, it is commonly used for water purification and disinfection.
 
• It is also used in the textile and paper industries for bleaching fabrics and pulp.
